claim: The alt ROM spare block 0x386E-0x3CFF is a patch location, but it copies NextZXOS ROM3, not Sinclair's all-0xFF area, so ROM data and vectors there must stay intact.

evidence.text: NextZXOS ROM3 is not free at 0x386E: its IM 1 handler CALLs 0x386E (0x004A) and its UDG print JPs 0x387E (0x0B52).
evidence.quote: NextZXOS ROM3 is not free at 0x386E: Its IM 1 handler CALLs 0x386E and its UDG print JPs 0x387E

evidence.text: The intro uses IM 2 with I = 3B: ROM 3BFF-3C00 is its vector. Hooks must leave them FF; JNext headless found it.
evidence.quote: The intro uses IM 2 with I = 3B: ROM 3BFF-3C00 is its vector. Hooks must leave them FF; JNext headless found it.

evidence.text: 192-231 ROM bytes the game runs or reads in each recording differ from Sinclair's (0x0550-0x06A7: LD-BYTES / SAVE area); the ROM path check reports them.
evidence.quote: 192-231 ROM bytes the game runs or reads in each recording differ from Sinclair's

evidence.text: El Capitan Trueno: a map of 0xFF bytes assumed at 0x3B00 let the plotter draw into the ULA until the build copied 0xFF over 0x3B00-0x3CFF; MAME models the alt ROM as NextZXOS ROM3 and caught it, the boot simulation did not.
